_comment: Tier-2 for dune::stokes#5 — a 0 where a None belongs in the DirichletBC value list pins the pressure. EXECUTED 2026-08-06 against dune-fem 2.12.0.2 in the dune-fem-env conda env (the runner needs DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python; there is no ofa-dune env on this host). Mechanism, read off the objects: DirichletBC(W, [profile, 0, None], ind).value keeps the None in slot 2 while .ufl_value is byte-identical to the 0 form's — dune/ufl/__init__.py::DirichletBC.__init__ does self.value = value and then builds ufl_value with [0 if v is None else v for v in value]. Consequence, counted from scheme.dirichletBlocks on a P2/P1 Taylor-Hood pair: at 8x8 both forms constrain the SAME 264 velocity dofs, and the None form constrains 0 pressure dofs against the 0 form's 68; at 16x16 it is 520 velocity dofs either way, 0 against 132. The pressure on the constrained boundary is EXACTLY 0.000000e+00 with the 0 entry and 2.000000e+00 with None, at both levels, and the solutions differ by 2.0 in the max norm. So the claim is CONFIRMED. CORRECTION TO AN EARLIER RESULT, recorded because a passing fixture asserted the opposite: stokes#5 was previously left uncovered on the strength of 'a 0 in the pressure slot did NOT drive the inlet pressure to zero (|p| max 1.543121 against 2.000000 with None)'. 1.543121 is the GLOBAL pressure maximum, not the boundary one. The inlet mask there was built by interpolating [x[0], x[1], 0] and slicing the PRESSURE leg, which returns the constant-0 third component — so every pressure dof tested as lying on x = 0 and the 'inlet maximum' was the global maximum. Interpolating the coordinates INTO the pressure leg instead ([0, 0, x[0]]) gives 25 boundary pressure dofs at 8x8 and a boundary maximum of exactly zero. MUTATION EVIDENCE: substituting a DirichletBC in which the 0 behaves like the None — no pressure dof constrained, boundary pressure free — made the fixture print zero_slot_constrains_pressure_dofs=False, zero_slot_pins_boundary_pressure_to_exactly_zero=False, over_constraint_grows_with_refinement=False, zero_slot_changes_the_solution=False and pressure_slot_must_be_none_not_zero=False, emit three FAIL: lines, drop the OK sentinel and return 2. dune.grid / dune.fem are imported at module scope, so without DUNE the process dies on import and the runner records a failure, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 puts None in the pressure slot of the "zero" run as well, so both runs use the correct spelling. DirichletBC maps None and 0 to the same ufl_value, so no new module is compiled. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'zero_slot_constrains_pressure_dofs=True', 'zero_slot_pins_boundary_pressure_to_exactly_zero=True', 'over_constraint_grows_with_refinement=True', 'zero_slot_changes_the_solution=True', 'pressure_slot_must_be_none_not_zero=True', 'dune_stokes_pressure_slot_gate=OK' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
